etsy.title: Christmas Family Games Bundle Printable, Christmas Bingo 8 Cards, Scavenger Hunt, Would You Rather, Charades, Trivia for Kids and Adults
etsy.description:
Christmas Eve, family gathering or class party, sorted in one print. 🎄

Seven easy games that work for kids and grown-ups together. Print, cut and play: no apps, no setup stress.

WHAT'S INSIDE (13 pages)
• Christmas Bingo: 8 different cards + 30 caller cards
• Indoor Christmas scavenger hunt (16 items)
• 24 Would You Rather cards
• 24 charades cards
• 24 Pictionary words
• 20 Christmas trivia questions + answers
• Family score sheet

AGES: 4 and up (younger kids play in a team).

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped.
You get 2 PDFs: US Letter and A4. Print at home or at a print shop. For personal use only.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
